faq.question: What is ICAN Academy?
faq.answer: ICAN Academy is a premier English language academy located in Ortigas, Manila, Philippines - often called the 'Daechi-dong of the Philippines.' Since 2006, we have provided high-quality English education with thinking-centered creative teaching methods.

faq.question: What does ICAN stand for?
faq.answer: ICAN stands for 'Imagine | Create | Analyze | Nurture | Polish @ Persuade' - reflecting our educational philosophy of helping students develop comprehensive skills.

faq.question: What age groups does ICAN serve?
faq.answer: ICAN serves students from age 7 through university students, with programs tailored to different levels.

faq.question: How long is the training period?
faq.answer: Summer vacation minimum 8 weeks, winter vacation 12 weeks or more preferred. At least 8 weeks is recommended for learning effectiveness.

faq.question: How many hours of class per day?
faq.answer: 8 hours per day (8AM-5PM with lunch 12-1PM), consisting of 4 classes with 4 different teachers.

faq.question: Can students continue online after returning home?
faq.answer: Yes, students can continue with the same teacher through ICAN's online system after returning to Korea.

faq.question: What is the EduSpace AI Hub?
faq.answer: The EduSpace AI Hub on the 11th floor is ICAN's second campus - an innovation lab for AI Orienteering, space projects, problem-solving activities, and media education.

faq.question: What unique learning materials does ICAN have?
faq.answer: ICAN has developed Caterpillar (vocabulary notebook), Visionary Journal (writing notebook), ICAN Interview (assessment tool), ICAN Herald (student newspaper), and TOEFL Cornell Notebooks.

faq.question: How does the student management system work?
faq.answer: A Facebook Messenger group chat is created with principal, head teacher, 4 assigned teachers, and parents. Teachers provide daily real-time updates on learned content, class videos, progress, and homework.

faq.question: What is SSP?
faq.answer: SSP (Student Study Permit) is a required permit for foreign students studying in the Philippines. Cost is 10,000 pesos, valid for 6 months (permit) and 1 year (card).
